derivation.rule: Viewed outcomes may motivate V2.2 but none of those windows may be rescored as fresh validation.

newFactor.name: incremental earnings bridge
newFactor.reason: V2.1 could over-credit a large generic segment even when the specific new bottleneck product had not yet become economically material. V2.2 requires point-in-time evidence that the new demand can plausibly move revenue or earnings, or that shipment/order proof is already strong.
